note: The actor gets 1943.43 DOLA from the V3 pool for 5.962 INV, then buys the 5.962 INV back from V2 pool 0x5ba6 for 1922.1 DOLA, so INV closes exactly. The leftover 21.33 DOLA is swapped on 0xecfb for 0.008108 WETH, which is unwrapped and forwarded to the sender as ETH. That ETH exceeds the 0.007591 ETH gas fee by a thin margin, counting actor and sender together.
